title: Quick Crispy German Mushroom Skillet
description: A charred, crispy German dish featuring wild mushrooms, render fat, and kosher friendly ingredients, perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Heat the rendered fat in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wild mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the salt, black pepper, paprika, and caraway seeds, and stir to combine.
Continue cooking the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms are crispy and charred.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the mushroom mixture and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the skillet to a plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the skillet hot and enjoy.
